concepts.gloss_en: Knowledge and comprehension/attainment (hasagah) of the Torah — adds the distinct element of hasagah, not merely knowing

members.note: representative; compound construct with added head השגה

notes: Different construct heads: ידיעה alone vs. ידיעה+השגה (attainment). Rule 4 — added possessed/construct head is a distinct concept. Also different Torah contexts (lm1:74 vs lm1:101). Kept separate per under-merge preference.
